notes.cache: prompt_eval_cached_count is a response metric in Go types, not a documented prompt cache control.
notes.duration: keep_alive accepts numeric seconds or Go duration strings; negative is indefinite; zero unloads.
notes.embedInput: Go source accepts strings, arrays and multimodal text/image/audio maps; image/audio are base64 blobs. OpenAPI may lag.
notes.images: Go ImageData is []byte; JSON image values are base64 strings.
notes.stream: Chat and generate stream newline-delimited JSON by default; embed and show return JSON.
notes.toolCalls: id is optional; function.index is an integer and arguments is a JSON object. Source does not specify a general repeated-index fragment merge algorithm.
